name: MarkCodePolo by Freakmont Warriors
tagline: Generates navigable diagrams of a codebase for both people and coding agents.

awards: MLH: Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry

problem: Large codebases intimidate new engineers and cost agents many tokens to read.
solution: An orchestrator of uAgents indexes a repository's symbols, data flow and structure; Gemini produces an annotated graph served on a website, an MCP server and OmegaClaw.
demo_moment: Team-described: point it at a repo and browse the generated graph.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH: Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry” among 307 submissions.
One index serves humans and agents.

lessons: Build once for both the human reader and the agent reader.
